exercises.explanation: Correct pattern for Articles a / an / the: Use a/an for singular countable nouns mentioned for the first time or as examples. Use the when the listener knows which

exercises.explanation: Use a/an for singular countable nouns mentioned for the first time or as examples. Use the when the listener knows which one. No article with plural g
